name: Duskfall Thicket
source:
When three Fairies find a human corpse, they must go on a journey beyond their forest.

[From [url=https://the-darkmess.itch.io/duskfall-thicket]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
三個精靈發現一具人類屍體，為此不得不踏上旅途，離開自己生活的森林。

［摘自[url=https://the-darkmess.itch.io/duskfall-thicket]itch.io[/url]］
